name: skills-policy
description: OpenAgent SDK skills policy vectors. A skill is a capability an agent can invoke; a skill policy decides whether an agent is allowed to invoke a given skill on a given target. This combines OAS identity, Arsenal scope evaluation, and skill-level constraints (rate limits, cost budgets, input validation).
spec: OpenAgent SDK skills + Arsenal policy integration

vectors.name: allow-skill-with-matching-scope
vectors.description: Agent has scope openai:chat:invoke and calls the chat skill

vectors.name: deny-skill-without-scope
vectors.description: Agent lacks the required scope for the skill

vectors.name: allow-skill-with-wildcard
vectors.description: Agent has openai:*:* and calls the chat skill

vectors.name: allow-within-rate-limit
vectors.description: Skill invocation within per-minute rate limit is allowed

vectors.name: deny-exceeding-rate-limit
vectors.description: Skill invocation exceeding per-minute rate limit is denied

vectors.name: allow-within-cost-budget
vectors.description: Skill invocation within USD cost budget is allowed

vectors.name: deny-exceeding-cost-budget
vectors.description: Skill invocation exceeding cost budget is denied

vectors.name: validate-input-schema-pass
vectors.description: Input that matches the skill's JSON schema is accepted

vectors.name: validate-input-schema-missing-required
vectors.description: Input missing a required field is rejected

vectors.name: validate-input-schema-wrong-type
vectors.description: Input with wrong type is rejected

vectors.name: compound-policy-all-conditions-allow
vectors.description: When scope + rate limit + cost budget all permit, the decision is allow

vectors.name: compound-policy-one-failure-denies
vectors.description: When any single condition fails, the decision is deny
